params.1273: Bring four pieces of cooked food to Sister Judith.
params.1274: If you need more food, get more by killing trolls, farming, hunting, fishing or cooking.
params.1275: Use some cooked food on a refugee by <col=FFFFFF>right-clicking</col> and selecting <col=FFFFFF>use</col>, then clicking on the refugee.
params.1276: If you left-click on the food, you will eat it instead, and the refugees will be sad!
